data.title: OpenAPI como fonte única de verdade

items: Client SDK em TS/Python/Go (via openapi-generator, orval, kubb)

data.code:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Users API
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /users/{id}:
    get:
      operationId: getUser
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: id
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/User' }
              examples:
                default:
                  value: { id: "u1", email: "a@b.c", age: 30 }
        '404':
          description: Not Found
components:
  schemas:
    User:
      type: object
      required: [id, email]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        email: { type: string, format: email }
        age: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }

# Orval — gera client com TanStack Query + Zod schemas
npx orval --config orval.config.ts

# Kubb — gera tipos + client + Zod em uma passada
npx kubb generate

# openapi-typescript — só tipos
npx openapi-typescript openapi.yaml -o types.ts

data.title: Mock server: frontend sem esperar backend

data.code:
# Prism: mock dinâmico baseado em schema
npx @stoplight/prism-cli mock openapi.yaml
# → http://localhost:4010 responde conforme o spec

# MSW (frontend-only): intercepta fetch no browser durante dev
# handlers gerados automaticamente a partir do OpenAPI
